blurb: Located in the heart of Niagara wine country and moments from historic Old Town Niagara-on-the-Lake, Lailey Winery has been farming and producing beautiful, authentic wines for more than 40 years. With roots as grape growers since 1973, we began honing the craft of winemaking with hard work, hustle, and a whole lot of love. It is this creativity and passion that we pour into every bottle.
